name: The Blackwater Leviathan
blurb: The Blackwater Leviathan is a sea-serpent rising out of the black water, his neck in a slow S and two coils of his body humped out of the water at his sides: dark teal scales with pale edges and pale green plates down his throat, a dragon's head with orange eyes, a frill of fins and a ridge of spines, a great pearl set in his crown, an iron collar with a chain hanging from it into the water, a harpoon in his chest with red rags, and barnacles in clusters.
next: his scales bigger and leafier as the sheet paints them, his coils egg-shaped, and a closer camera on the phone page.
